subtopic: Reshaping Data (Pivot Tables, Melt, Stack, Unstack)
question_text: [Data Cleaning, Wrangling & Transformation (Pandas) - Q32] In tidy data principles, what transformation does Pandas `melt()` perform on a DataFrame?

options.text: Unpivots a DataFrame from wide format to long format, gathering column headers into a variable column and values into a value column
Pivots a DataFrame from long format to wide format
Drops duplicate rows based on index
Merges two tables on primary keys

answer_explanation: `melt()` reverses wide format structures, consolidating multiple metric columns into key-value attribute pairs for relational reporting.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: `melt()` reverses wide format structures, consolidating multiple metric columns into key-value attribute pairs for relational reporting.

criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
